_owner_note: OWNER-WRITES-ONLY. Agents read this and never modify it. Every number below is a PLACEHOLDER seeded from typical Orange County market rates — replace with your real rates before quoting anything. Agents must refuse to quote a line item that is not listed here.

minimums._note: A job below the minimum is billed at the minimum, not declined.

labor._note: Billed in 0.5 h increments after the first hour.

day_rates._note: Day rate includes operator + equipment, excludes travel beyond zone 0.

multipliers._note: Rush applies only when the job displaces scheduled work.

terms._note: Late fee must appear on the accepted quote to be enforceable.

tax._owner_action: Look up the current combined rate at the CDTFA rate lookup and set it here. Left null on purpose so nothing quietly quotes a stale rate.
tax._note: Services are generally not subject to CA sales tax; tangible personal property we hand over generally is. Any invoice with a tangible line item gets tax_review_required=true and a CPA decides.

data_retention._note: Stated on every quote. Raw scans belong to the client on request.
